name: calculate
description: Write live Excel formulas (INDEX/MATCH / SUMIFS / arithmetic / conditional IF / #REF! repair) onto a new sheet; never paste dead totals

tools.name: calculate_table
tools.description: Write LIVE formulas to a NEW sheet (never overwrite sources, never paste computed totals). op lookup: INDEX/MATCH. op sumifs|sumifs_multi: unique groupBy (one or many columns) + optional fixed criteria[] + SUMIFS. op arithmetic: declarative column math via expression.terms (column|literal|sheetCell). op conditional_column: one IF column (eq|neq|gt|gte|lt|lte|between). op fix_ref: copy sheet dropping #REF!. Tables must exist (ensure_table first).

op.description: lookup | sumifs | sumifs_multi | arithmetic | conditional_column | fix_ref

bringColumns.description: lookup: columns to fetch from right, comma-separated

groupBy.description: sumifs: category column, or comma-separated / array for multi-column groups
